reason: In uploads_controller.rb:41-44 the patch calls OptimizedImage.downsize(tempfile.path, ...), and optimize() only uses the animated (gifsicle) path when `from =~ /\.GIF$/i` (optimized_image.rb:77). Gemfile.lock pins rack 1.5.5, which I recall names multipart tempfiles `Tempfile.new("RackMultipart")` with no extension; I couldn't open the gem source here to check. So the regex fails and downsize_instructions runs `convert #{from}[0]` (optimized_image.rb:129), keeping only the first frame of an animated GIF.
